_comment: Single source of truth for the Studyboard capture endpoint contract used by the NATIVE clients (iOS App Intents / Share extension, Android AppFunctions / share receiver) and by tests/capture-contract.test.js. cap-server owns the real function (supabase-functions/capture-task): if it changes a field or limit, change it here too and re-run `node tests/capture-contract.test.js`. STATUS: confirmed against supabase-functions/capture-task (cap-server).

headers.note: X-Studyboard-Token is accepted instead of Authorization; the server accepts any Idempotency-Key up to 80 chars (or an 'id' body field) and dedupes for 7 days

due.note: free text such as 'friday 5pm' or an ISO date (2026-10-09 or 2026-10-09T17:00); the server stores natural language raw and the app's own parser reads it in the user's time zone; the server keeps the first 60 characters of free text

course.note: longer than 60 is cut to 60 by the server (a course hint only needs to match a course name)

source.note: the server accepts any short label (letters, digits . _ -, 24 max); 'test' is used by the in-app Test it button

response.speech: string (one short sentence, safe to read aloud)

sharedQueueItem._comment: Shape of one item that the native layer (App Group container on iOS, files dir on Android) hands to window.SBCAPTURE.ingest(item) through the StudyboardSharedQueue plugin.
